facts.fact: 四下死寂，Leung 不见踪影，来时穿过的卵石屏障也找不到了。
facts.anchor: It was eerily quiet here. Leung was nowhere to be seen

facts.fact: 只剩一根红线系在她腰间的带扣上，另一头拖进黑暗里。
facts.anchor: Only the red thread fastened to her belt loop, trailing into darkness.

facts.fact: 她提醒自己：眼前一切都是让她迷失方向的幻象。
facts.anchor: It was all an illusion to keep her disorientated.

facts.fact: 一个穿丧服蓝、没有脸的人径直前行，完全不理她。
facts.anchor: A faceless figure in funeral blue, walking forward steadily, ignoring her entirely.

facts.fact: 无脸的人一排接一排，缓慢而稳定地往前走，往下一世去。
facts.anchor: Row upon row of them, moving at a slow, steady pace.

facts.fact: 她后颈发麻，但这次没有逃；没找到祖母她不会走。
facts.anchor: Hairs prickled down her neck, but this time she did not run.

facts.fact: 那些人看着都一样，可她认祖母不只靠眼睛。
facts.anchor: They might look the same, but she knew her grandmother by more than sight.

facts.fact: 祖母走路一脚高一脚低，左腿因旧伤拖着。
facts.anchor: The uneven gait of her walk, left leg dragging from an old injury.

facts.fact: 她闭眼把气用在嗅觉与听觉上，而不是力气和速度。
facts.anchor: Kiamling put her qi not into strength or speed but into her sense of smell and sound.

facts.fact: 她像开了天眼，在人堆里定位到祖母。
facts.anchor: Like her third eye had been opened, she could pinpoint Por Por in the crowd.

facts.fact: 那层壳像柚子皮一样被撕下，一块块落在她手里。
facts.anchor: It peeled like the tough skin of a pomelo, chunks of it coming away in her hands.

facts.fact: 祖母睁眼第一句是嫌她来得慢，随后往前倒进她怀里。
facts.anchor: “Aiyah, took you long enough,” the old woman said.

facts.fact: 她用力拽了两下红线，线绷紧，把她拉回屏障这一侧。
facts.anchor: Kiamling tugged sharply twice on the red thread.

facts.fact: Hoi 跪在地上，枷扣在颈上，重量把他往下坠。
facts.anchor: Hoi was on his knees, the pillory snapped around his neck, the weight of it dragging him down.

facts.fact: 她想明白：枷是 Leung 亲手扣上的，他出卖了他们。
facts.anchor: Because – her own brain belatedly provided the answer – he was the one who had fastened it. He had betrayed them.

facts.fact: 她朝木匠撒了一把米和盐，落在他脸上滋滋作响。
facts.anchor: She threw a handful of rice and salt at the carpenter.

facts.fact: 她的剑穿过枷上的头孔，擦过 Hoi 的脖子，扎进 Leung 的肩。
facts.anchor: The sword found the head hole of the pillory, narrowly missing Hoi’s neck and finding its target deep in Leung’s shoulder.

facts.fact: 两人把写满字的绸符平铺在地板的符号上，白线发蓝光，门被封住。
facts.anchor: together they laid the fu flat over the painted symbol on the floor

facts.fact: 她明白整件事是抓他们的陷阱，牢房才是要守的地方。
facts.anchor: The whole thing had been a trap to capture them.

facts.fact: Lancaster 带警察端枪进来抓人，说他不在乎控制，只要一场战争。
facts.anchor: “Control?” Lancaster laughed as if the notion had never crossed his mind. “Who cares about control? We just want war.”

facts.fact: 楼上的谈话照旧进行时，一名警察用银刀割开了 Leung 的喉咙。
facts.anchor: one of the officers slit his throat open with a silver blade

facts.fact: 她放弃呼救：总督未必知道细节，结果却一样收下。
facts.anchor: Bowring might not know the exact details, but he accepted the results all the same.

facts.fact: 她想起 Lady Bowring 给的破镜与新名字：合意时是慈善，不合意时就是暴力。
facts.anchor: Philanthropy when it suited them, violence when it did not.

facts.fact: 她被推进牢房、门在身后锁上，始终一句话没说。
facts.anchor: Kiamling kept her mouth shut, saying nothing as the officers shoved her into one of the cells and locked the door behind.
